scope: Independent whole hosted-release source assessment after two hosted failures; no implementation

verdictA.reason: Hosted setup now has the correct nested manifest, uv, pinned records source, and a committed shared-package refresh. No successful hosted candidate or exact-package native guest/member acceptance exists in the evidence inspected.
evidence: Run 37093086895 passed preflight, both checkouts, pinned-source verification, pnpm, Node, uv and frozen install; failed check:matrx-packages before publication.
36d5c94f refreshes shared packages, commits only package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml locally, refuses residual dirty files, then delegates publication to release.sh.
release.sh regenerates API types, canonical records guide, catalog and DB tool documentation into the candidate; all required strict checks and both package gates remain.
Store publication remains 0.2.130 according to the canonical record; hosted success alone cannot close native exact-package acceptance or Store submission.

verdictB.reason: Two Important interoperability gaps remain: failure diagnostics are lost and dependency provenance is not enforced when main advances.

findings.title: Failed hosted releases discard the detailed diagnostic log
evidence: .github/workflows/release.yml:182 has the only log artifact upload and inherits the default success condition.
Run 37093086895 skipped Upload validated release artifacts. gh run view --log-failed shows only matrx-packages failed exit 1; the individual failing package/version is absent.
release.sh run_checks appends the actual command output to RELEASE_LOG_FILE, then prints only the summary. The hosted runner is subsequently discarded.
findings.action: Add a separate always-run diagnostic-log upload using a run-unique name. Keep validated ZIP/receipt upload gated on successful candidate verification. Verify a failed hosted gate retains the detailed log.

findings.title: A merged candidate can use dependencies from a different lockfile
evidence: Workflow lines 128-145 install and refresh dependencies before release.sh fetches main.
release.sh:251-260 accepts a newer remote tree or merges it with the local package-refresh commit; lines 416-431 repeat candidate creation after a push race.

release.sh:182 symlinks every candidate snapshot to the original runner node_modules. No install or equality guard reconciles a changed candidate lockfile, package manifest or dependency configuration.

check-matrx-packages only audits @ai-matrx packages. A compatible ordinary dependency version change can therefore leave source/receipt identity correct while the compiled dependency bytes differ from the committed lock.
scripts/test-release-ship-path.sh exercises foreign text-file races through stubbed pnpm; it does not exercise a changed dependency graph.
findings.action: Bind installed dependencies to each merged candidate before generation/check/build, or fail closed when relevant dependency inputs differ from the installed source. Cover a dependency-changing remote race; preserve all strict checks.

otherAssessment.privileges: contents:write is needed for atomic main/tag publication; AI Dream checkout uses its separate deploy key with persist-credentials:false. No new token-prefix rule, grant, rotation, or credential read was needed for this assessment.
otherAssessment.recordsSource: Full SHA input is checked against the AI Dream checkout; generator imports matrx_records from that pinned workspace through uv. API types intentionally come from the live backend, not from that SHA. Do not describe the entire regeneration as an immutable backend snapshot.
otherAssessment.candidateIdentity: The actual release source may differ from workflow dispatch head because checkout tracks main, package refresh creates a commit, and release.sh merges later main. Receipt sourceSha plus remote tag is the correct identity; use it for acceptance.
otherAssessment.minorCopy: Workflow comments call Store upload a separate human step despite standing agent authorization. This is misleading operator text, not an actual permission or acceptance gate.

limits: Read-only source and existing hosted-run assessment; no local build, tests or browser executed under the low-disk constraint.
HR-2 is a direct source-level provenance finding; no runtime race reproduction was performed in this lane.
No claim of green hosted release, native guest/member behavior, signout privacy, upload, submission or publication.
